title: Lab 01 — First Contact: Locators, Auto-Waiting & Precise Assertions

variants.hint: Something about how money is displayed is wrong for some citations. How exact is your amount assertion?
variants.debrief: Amounts lost their trailing zero (£125.5 instead of £125.50). A toContainText('£125') assertion can't see that; toHaveText('£125.50') can. Assert the exact user-visible value.

variants.hint: Real users don't type the way the data is stored. Re-read R2.
variants.debrief: The server stopped normalising case, so 'cit-002' returned 'No citation found'. Requirements like 'case-insensitive' only get tested if you turn them into a test case.

variants.hint: What should happen when the user submits nothing at all?
variants.debrief: Empty input was sent to the backend and came back as 'No citation found' instead of 'Enter a citation ID'. Edge-case inputs (empty, whitespace) are where validation bugs live.

variants.hint: Each of your tests probably starts from a clean page. Users don't -- what happens to an old message after the NEXT search?
variants.debrief: After an unknown-ID error, a successful search showed the result but left the red error on screen. Single-action tests miss state that leaks between actions; test sequences, and assert what should be GONE.
